lines.beaver_en: Hello, I'm the building manager. What's bothering you?
lines.en: Hello. The air conditioning doesn't work properly.

lines.beaver_en: The AC? It's not cool even when it's on?
lines.en: Yes, no matter how much I run it, the room is hot.

lines.beaver_en: Ah, dust has built up in the filter. I'll clean it.
lines.en: Thanks. The microwave keeps turning off too.

lines.beaver_en: The microwave? When does it turn off?
lines.en: It turns off as soon as I put a container in and start it.

lines.beaver_en: I'll try changing the plug. What about the gas stove?
lines.en: The gas stove is fine, but I smell gas.

lines.beaver_en: A gas smell? That's dangerous. I'll check right away.
lines.en: It smelled all night, so I was really scared.

lines.beaver_en: The valve was loose. I tightened it, so it's fine now.
lines.en: Please check the heater and the humidifier too.

lines.beaver: 둘 다 잘 돼요. 다리미는 어때요?
lines.beaver_en: Both work fine. How about the iron?
lines.beaver_roman: dul da jal dwaeyo. darimineun eottaeyo?
lines.learner: 다리미가 뜨겁지 않아서 다림질을 못 해요.
lines.en: The iron doesn't get hot, so I can't do any ironing.
lines.roman: darimiga tteugeopji anaseo darimjireul mot haeyo.

lines.beaver: 새 다리미로 바꿔 드릴게요. 다른 건요?
lines.beaver_en: I'll replace it with a new iron. Anything else?
lines.beaver_roman: sae darimiro bakkwo deurilgeyo. dareun geonyo?
lines.en: The picture frame above the dressing table keeps falling.

lines.beaver: 못을 다시 박을게요. 이제 다 됐어요.
lines.beaver_en: I'll put the nail back in. Now everything's done.
lines.beaver_roman: moseul dasi bageulgeyo. ije da dwaesseoyo.
lines.learner: 정말 감사해요. 이제 편하게 살 수 있겠어요.
lines.en: Thank you so much. Now I can live comfortably.
lines.roman: jeongmal gamsahaeyo. ije pyeonhage sal su itgesseoyo.
